This unique formulation provides gentle chemical exfoliation that smooths texture and brightens the complexion, while also offering potent antioxidant protection against environmental stressors. Applied using pre-saturated pads, the peel is incredibly easy to integrate into a routine. I noted immediate results, observing significantly smoother texture and more even skin tone after the first application. While designed for daily i prefer to use the pads two to three times per week to prevent potential dryness. Crucially, due to the AHA content, it is mandatory to follow up with broad-spectrum sunscreen daily while using this product to protect against increased sun sensitivity. I highly recommend this product to everyone.

I did 3 days a week so far and face feels smooth. Happy with product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My face has been looking so great lately even with the dry winter air. I've loved the feel and scent of it. It's easy to use and I've gotten a lot of compliment

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried this product both in the morning underneath my makeup and at night after washing my face and prefer to use it in the evening because it makes your skin feel tight, like there is dried glue on it. The pads are small but still managed to cover my entire face. I used this product for several days and didn't notice a difference in the overall tone and look of my skin. I have uneven skin tone and lots of freckles and sun spots, so this probably wasn't the right product to use to see a difference in these areas.

avis.titre: Keeps your skin looking fresh without too much effort
avis.texte: It's basically an easy, everyday glow booster. It gently smooths your skin and helps fade dullness without feeling harsh or stingy. The citric acid and AHA/PHA mix do the exfoliating for you, and most people notice softer, brighter skin pretty quickly. It's simple to use, plays well with the rest of your routine, and is a nice pick if you want something that keeps your skin looking fresh without too much effort.
My wife loves these pads for her skin care routine. They are great for exfoliating and smoothing her skin and lightening dark spots. They have a fresh citrus scent and come in a nice glass jar.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this on my jawline and my neck since I received to hopefully lighten some stubborn spots. I like that there is no scent and the pads aren't too thin. Once you rub in the remaining product your skin is slightly sticky for a bit until dried down but not too bad. I haven't had a reaction using these nightly or dryness. Too soon to see the be spots lighten but looking forward to results!
I was really excited to try this product, and it did not disappoint. The formula is strong but gave me immediate results. After consistent use, I've been so happy with my new routine!

I received this product for free for my honest review. This is a really nice exfoliation pad. One side is textured with little bumps, the other side is smooth. I used the textured side first then the smooth side. There's definitely a tingling sensation while using. The product has a scent but not noticeable while using whatsoever. My skin felt a little tight afterwards so moisturizing is highly recommended! But my skin looks brighter and the flakiness disappeared.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Good for exfoliating the face and everyday use. It works gently on the skin but i can still feel a little bit of tingling sensation on my skin. I have sensitive skin but it doesn't irritate it.

avis.titre: Great for sensitive skin and it's quick and easy
avis.texte: Exuviance Daily Resurfacing Leave On Face Peel is a very effective and gentle facial peel. If you are someone, like me, who loves peels but has sensitive skin then this peel is for you. I love that these are pads that you just swipe all over your face and toss. They are meant to be used daily and left on without rinsing off. Its quick, easy, one step process. I apply it in the morning but make sure to use sunscreen as it contains 10% Citric Acid. I did noticed that it is very effective in exfoliating which is why I like it so much. I like chemical exfoliates instead of physical ones that can harm your skin. Overall, I would purchase this product because it does really work exfoliating the skin and its so easy to use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I actually thought this was like a cleanser now a wipe. But really like it as a wipe you see how much it pick up. I liked that it did not leave my face red at all it actually left my face super soft. I have oily face and it after using it is like it picked up all the oil without the itchiness.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product leaves my face feeling sticky and tacky with a residue left behind. I do think that it does a good job of cleaning my skin, but I can't say that I would purchase it again. You also need to be careful applying it too close to your lips, as it has an awful taste. Lastly, I find that these pads are difficult to peel apart. I end up picking up a few pads at once and needing to separate them. I wish this came with a pair of tweezers or something for ease.

avis.titre: Great for smooth, clean skin but may sting on acne.
avis.texte: I've been using the Exuviance Daily Resurfacing Peel and overall I really like it. The product makes my skin feel smoother, cleaner, and more refreshed after each use. My complexion looks brighter and more even, and it helps remove dull, dead skin effectively. However, if you currently have active acne or sensitive spots, it can sting a little when applied. The sensation goes away after a short time, but it's something to keep in mind. Despite that, I still think it's a great exfoliating product for improving skin texture and giving your face a healthy glow with consistent use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Honestly, I don't feel like it did anything for my skin. It had a burning feeling though but I've heard others say that so I was already prepared for that feeling. There's no scent which is nice.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the result I see from using these pads daily. I use them each morning before makeup. They help remove any dead skin and help with redness and dry patches that I have. As someone who has tried a lot of different exfoliating pads and treatments I think the end result of this is on par for competitors, but the size of the pad is much smaller and less saturated than others. I think there are other pads out there for better price that can do the same thing. While the glass jar is fancy, I struggle with getting the lid on and off. A plastic container with a flip top would be much easier and probably cheaper to make which could be passed on to the consumer.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I used the pads on my arms. The pad became lightly yellow/brown as compared to a new white pad. The skin felt a little smoother afterwards and did not feel too dry. The only thing I wish is the pad to be bigger but I would recommend.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This feels soooo good on the skin!!! It's super soft and I like the idea of the pads as well. You get a little over a months supply too so not too bad either

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have sensitive skin and these pads didn't break me out or cause irritation. My skin does look and feel smoother as far as texture goes. There is no scent which is nice. I enjoy using these. I feel brighter.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have to say I felt this product was working on my skin, but I think it's a bit too harsh for me. It kind of left a burning sensation after applying and you have to be really careful and make sure you're not exposing yourself to the sun and wearing sunscreen a week after applying. I like the packaging and I felt like it's a good product, it's just too harsh for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been testing the Exuviance Daily Resurfacing Peel, and my skin is definitely loving the glow it gives. My initial reaction was a light tingling—nothing harsh, just that 'it's working' feeling you expect from an AHA. It absorbs super fast, too. The pad glides on easily and dries down within seconds, so it layers well under the rest of my routine without pilling. As for how long it lasts? The smoothness and brightness show up pretty quickly, and I notice that fresh, refined-skin look all day. After a few uses, my texture started improving and my skin just looks more even overall. Just make sure you're using sunscreen like they recommend, because the peel definitely makes your skin more sun-sensitive.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ok I love this stuff. I have some sun spots that I wanted to work on getting rid of. So far any product I have used hasn't made me feel like any changes have been made. This product may burn at times (depending on the product you use before it) but it really works. The moment you put it on you feel it's working its magic. It doesn't have a strong scent which I love and makes my skin super soft after use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Let me start off by saying, I take several medications that make my skin very dry and sensitive. I also get acne when I change products. I've been using this peel for about a week and a half if not a little more and it's worked wonders. The first day it did sting a little but nothing too bad. I continued my regular skin care and didn't have high expectations. However, by day 3 or 4 I saw clearing of dark spots from acne marks as well as brighter complexion altogether. I've also noticed the need for less moisturizer at night since my skin is absorbing it much better. The container it comes with is glass and easy to open. The little pads aren't too thin so although they stick together they don't tear while separating. There really isn't anything bad I can say about it. I love it and will continue to use it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Literally I been getting non stop compliments on my skin glowing!!! I would highly recommend this to all !!!! Like it lets me soak in all my serums. I found it got rid of my dead skin too! Highly recommend it!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Packaging wise, this is very convenient. As someone who likes a good trip, I like that I can probably take this in my carry on. The small pads, the cute simple bottle is convenient. I've used this product now for a few weeks and man it stings. When I first tried it, I used it two days in a row and then took a break because I was unsure about why my skin felt like it was burning but then I saw that I was not unique so I went back. My skin feels softer and smoother and I love that. I make sure to really hydrate my skin when I use it and I think that helps.

avis.titre: Great for all types of skin types!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was surprised there was no scent at all! I've been using this product for a couple weeks to make sure that i saw a difference. I did! I am am older woman with sun damage, aging and wrinkles. I recommend this product because of the clean feeling i get after use. It is great before applying makeup as it dries quickly. I would have given this product the full 5 stars, except I didn't like the stickiness on my hand after applying the product. I would have loved to have been able to use this product during my younger years to avoid the sun damage and exposure i received.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Millennials, your muscle memory will kick in with these pads. Only this product is much superior. I love a quick pad to swipe over my face that packs a punch. It feels cool wet when applied but dries quickly and needs to be followed with a moisturizer. My skin has been getting more sensitive with age so I alternated every other night and had no redness or dryness. I tried this while pmsing and did not have my monthly breakout. I would recommend giving this a try and incorporating into your routine.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]. This is a great face product. Leaves face nice and clean. Doesn't have any scent . I use in morning and at night for face therapy. Don't break out are makes face burn. Highly recommended to anyone

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this product. I have kind of dull, uneven skin, I don't deal with a lot of issues currently but have really tailored my products to get to this point. I haven't been using a CA product, and this has definitely changed the game for me. My skin looks more radiant and like I'm glowing, and the only thing I've changed is adding this product. Sometimes it does pill under my moisturizer but I just rub my skin until it all pills off of my face. My freckles are still there but I don't want them to go away, I like them. This everyday peel is really expensive unfortunately, like $80 for 36 pads… which just isn't doable for me in this economy. I cut them each in half, and that is enough product for me & my face. I am usually sensitive but this doesn't break me out. No heavy scent, easy to apply the product & massage in extra.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Hmm I'm not sure if I completely liked this product. The bottle looks very fancy! It is heavy, made of glass, even the lid looks well made, the box itself is silky to touch - this I liked a lot. But it seems like you're paying for brand and packaging. I haven't noticed a big difference after using these pads. No resurfacing effect was noticeable. And the pad itself is very tiny and thin. I've used peels before, not in pads, but liquid ones, so I didn't have breakouts after this one, I think my skin adjusted to those already (Somethings it is normal to have breakouts when you just start using a new peel). It absorbs not completely and leaves film on top of my skin. I was excited to try this, but now I'm not sure if I'd repurchase it again.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the convenience of this peel. It's so easy to use and saves me time in my skin care regimen. It doesn't leave my skin feeling dry like most peels. I am able to remember to complete my peel much easier than before. I love this product! It's a must!

I'm mostly used to using stronger strengths of glycolic or salicylic acid so I was unsure how 10% citric acid would compare but on immediate first use I felt a sting on my face! This stuff works. You can feel a bit of residue and some tightness but the box says you can wear with moisturizer and under makeup. I prefer to use it at night. The pads are small but feel good quality, no cotton pilling.

I was super excited to receive this product! After reviewing it, I definitely did not like the fact that the pads were very small. It was hard to rub on my face because of the size! After using this product, I had a film over my face, it did not feel smooth, and it did not feel like it exfoliated my face.

avis.titre: It helps improve skins texture with constant use.
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I applied it under serum and moisturizer. Then, I went to bed only to wake up to clear skin. Simple and easy to incorporate into skincare routine. I was shocked and excited to see how great skin look. It helps improve skins texture with constant use. I've noticed a different in about 10 days of use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm someone who struggles with hormonal acne and I won't leave the house without makeup, I feel like acne will pop up any second and discoloration is so obvious on me. I started using this product and within 2 days, I was stunned. In total, I've been using this product for 10 days and I can confidently say it's changed my skin and my confidence. I put this on before bed and the smoothness I feel when putting moisturizer on both that night AND the morning is unmatched. I have less acne and less discoloration. This is the first time in a very long time I feel fine without wearing makeup. I am absolutely continuing using this product and I'm so thankful for it!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] These peel pads are such an easy add to my routine. One side is textured, the other is smooth, and together they give a really nice, controlled exfoliation without feeling harsh. They're quick to use and don't leave any residue. I noticed a difference in my skin texture after the first few uses — smoother, more even, and just overall better. No burning, no irritation, no redness. They just work, which I appreciate. They also sit well under moisturizer and makeup with zero issues. If you want something that gives results without being aggressive, these are a great pick.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is amazing, makes my skin soft and glow, first time I used was like my skin was resurfaced, with a great texture, I definitely recommend this product!

avis.titre: Made my skin so so good!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This resurfacing peel is absolutely amazing! Exfoliated my skin so so well! I could use this everyday and my skin absorbs it so well. The scent is amazing and it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin at all!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love the container! I do like this additional step in my routine - the pads help get hidden makeup and dirt off my face. However, my skin is left feeling a little sticky or tacky. I'm also not seeing much of a resurfacing result.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Exuviance Daily Resurfacing Peel for a few weeks now, and honestly, it's kind of a glow-up in a packet. My skin looks smoother, feels softer, and my texture has definitely calmed down. It gives that fresh, post-facial vibe without being too harsh.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using exuviance products for years now. I had the chance to try their Advanced series daily resurfacing peel. All I can say is I love this product. It makes my skin feel so soft and smooth. It looks brighter, and the texture is so much nicer. I will say that for anybody who's starting out with using a resurfacing peel like this, probably only do it a couple times a week. Until you can build up a tolerance on your skin. I use mine four days a week. And my skin, like I said, is beautiful.

This was a cool product to try. It left my skin nourished and left no residue . I would say it is good because it has no scent and feels natural along with absorbing into the skin so quickly . Leaves skin glowing and shiny just add moisturizer at the end

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Let's talk about this glow in a jar 💫 the Exuviance Advanced Series Daily Resurfacing Peel CA10. These pads are so easy to use and have quickly become part of my nighttime routine. They gently exfoliate without irritation, leaving my skin feeling fresh, smooth, and bright by morning. I noticed after just a few uses that my texture started improving makeup goes on smoother, and my skin has that healthy, glass-like glow. ✨ What I love most is that it feels luxurious but not harsh. It targets dullness and rough spots while being gentle enough for daily use. You can literally feel it working, but without that burning or tight feeling other peels can cause. If your skin needs a reset or you want that natural glow back, this one's worth it. But, olease be aware it has a high cost. 💜

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Unfortunately this product does not work well for sensitive skin. I washed my face and used one wipe only once and my face instantly felt like it was burning then got red and blotchy. Washed my face again to remove product and feeling better.

avis.titre: Exfoliation not Noticeable - Maybe Good for Sensitive Skin?
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have used a number of different "peel pads" over the years, and these are just okay. I have been using them daily for the last 2 weeks, and I don't really notice much of a difference. Other peel pads I have used have resulted in noticeable shedding of skin, and these have not at all. My skin feels tight and clean immediately after using them but beyond that the results are difficult to decipher. If you have sensitive skin, these may be a good option for you, but I prefer something with more powerful exfoliation. At this price point, I think there are better options out there, but I appreciate receiving them in exchange for my honest feedback.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is so useful. It exfoliates dead cells, rough spots. Antioxidant formula targets environmental stressors. It comes with 36 pads. It is cold leaves my skin refreshing and tight after each use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Im not sure if this product is bringing any changes to my skin. I do like the consistency and the texture of the pads. I will keep trying for a few more weeks to see if i see a difference. When initially used it did sting a bit until my skin got used to it. The packaging is nice but i felt its kind of expensive.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wasn't sure how I'd feel about these, but I'm so glad I got them to try!! They have made a big difference in my skin without drying or causing breakouts! I have very sensitive skin and will turn red or break out from most products. It's improved my skin texture, absorbs well, and is easy to layer with my other products! 10/10!!
